# ===================================================================
# CATEGORIES
# ===================================================================

@category: Crafts
@skills: Cooking, Drafting, Fletching, Horticulture,
@restricted: —
@stat_bonuses: Ag/Me/SD
@rank_progression: Combined
@category_progression: 0 • 0 • 0 • 0 • 0
@group: Craft
@classification: Static Maneuver
@description: This category encompasses the use of particular craftsman skills, such as making jewelry, copper etching, cloth work, etc. Note that these skills are all physical applications of skill to produce a desired object or product. Skills dealing with the abstract analysis or theory of these obects should fall instead under the Technical/Trade Group. The list above is not exhaustive; there is a nearly infinite number of possible crafts. The following is a partial list of suggested crafts not defined within this section (each of which is developed separately):

# ===================================================================
# SKILL DESCRIPTIONS
# ===================================================================

@@ Cooking
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus cooking or preparing food. This skill bonus may also be used when detecting bad food, or preparing neutralizing dangerous food ingredients.

@@ Drafting
@stat: SD
@description: This skill provides a bonus to draw an item, object, blue prints, etc. This is not free hand drawing; specialized drafting equipment (squares, triangles, compasses, etc.) is used in making accurate and precise drawings (normally to scale).

@@ Fletching
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for making an arrow out of available wood, metal, paper, and/or feathers. Note: With this skill, sophisticated types of special purpose arrows may be crafted (such as hunting, armor piercing, message, howling, poison bearing, etc.).

@@ Horticulture
@stat: Em
@description: This skill provides a bonus for growing flowers, fruits, fungi and vegetables. It includes the feeding, care, and harvesting of such plants.

@@ Leather-crafts
@stat: SD
@description: This skill provides a bonus for working with hides and creating leather goods (e.g., leather armor, bolas, etc.).

@@ Metal-crafts
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for working with normal metals to create or repair desired objects (e.g., horse shoes, metal ornaments). Bonus for oven or kiln building, and doubling effects of fires.

@@ Rope Mastery
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for knot recognition, knot-tying, braiding, rope splicing, making a maneuver while suspended from a rope (or analogous flexible line), or when throwing a line.

@@ Scribing
@stat: SD
@description: This skill gives proficiency in secretarial skills, including calligraphy, taking dictation and librarian skills.

@@ Service
@stat: SD
@description: This skill gives a bonus to performing service duties, such as those of a valet, maid, butler, etc.

@@ Sewing/Weaving
@stat: In
@description: This provides a bonus to static maneuvers involving sewing or weaving. These skills includes fashioning garments, blankets, etc., as well as repairing such items.

@@ Skinning
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for removing, preparing, treating and caring for animal skins. Note that while this would allow a simple drape to be fashioned, this does not provide the sewing skills necessary to create normal garments.

@@ Stone-crafts
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for working with stone and creating sculptures, writings, or any other form of inscription or relief.

@@ Trapping
@stat: Em
@description: This skill provides a bonus to trapping skills, including setting simple snares, identifying animal runs, and a knowledge of the values of various furs, skins, etc.

@@ Wood-crafts
@stat: In
@description: This skill provides a bonus for fashioning any object out of the required amount of wood, bone or similar material.

However, you are so oblivious and self-absorbed that you are convinced that you have, in fact, succeeded admirably. Your misguided efforts generate results similar to Absolute Failure, below, but you will defend yourself until irrefutable evidence is presented to you that you have failed.
-25 — 04 | Absolute Failure | -50% | 1.5u | -30 | In your haste, you have actually created extra work for yourself. The time to complete this task normally is doubled, and you have misplaced, misused or broken some or all of the people, tools or materials used in this task. You may not try again until 24 hours have passed, and that attempt will then be at a modification of -20.
05 — 75 | Failure | 0% | 1.0u | +0 | Your skills have deserted you, and you have wasted your effort. Hurts, don’t it?
UM 66 | Unusual Event | 100% | 1.5u | +10 | You have a great idea for a unique style for your craftwork, and after an arduous effort, you successfully realize your work. Unfortunately, unbeknownst to you, another local craftsman has had the same idea before you, and your work is seen as a bald imitation. Lips curl.
76 — 90 | Partial Success | 30% | 1.75u | +5 | You know what you want to accomplish, but it just keeps falling short. Perhaps a different approach. Wait a full day before attempting this skill again.
UM 100 | Unusual Success | 150% | 2.5u | +40 | You have achieved a perfect union of form and function. Your craftwork may be up to 30% lighter or heavier (player’s choice), and has an inherent non-magical bonus of +10 in addition to any other qualities. In addition, with an equivalent effort, you may reproduce this object exactly with a result of Absolute Success any time in the future. This could be your big-ticket item!
91 — 110 | Near Success | 80% | 1.5u | +10 | You aren’t quite on, it seems. The small details keep escaping you, but you may yet manage to catch up. It takes a bit longer, but you may roll again with a +10 modification to finish your maneuver.
111 — 175 | Success | 100% | 1.0u | +20 | Your hands are sure, and your work is precise and artful. You got etc. the knack.
176 up | Absolute Success | 120% | 0.8u | +30 | Your diligence is rewarded with your latest masterwork! Everyone can see the remarkable quality of your work, and your abilities will be more highly regarded than ever.
